description: Environment setup and baseline verification. Confirm the toolchain works in this sandbox (npm is only reachable via a PATH export) and that build + both test suites are green before making changes. Also create the feature branch.
steps: In every shell, prepend npm to PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (node v22.23.3; npm 11.4.2).

From /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster confirm the working tree is clean on main, then create and checkout the branch feat/chat-near-monster (branch off main). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches.
Run `npm run build` at the repo root and confirm it exits 0 (shared -> backend -> frontend tsc+vite -> infra).
Run `npm test` at the repo root and confirm shared tests pass (baseline 47/47).
Run `cd packages/frontend && npm test` and confirm the ui-helpers tests pass (baseline 50/50).
acceptance_criteria: Branch feat/chat-near-monster exists and is checked out, created from main.
findings: Branch feat/chat-near-monster created off clean main. PATH export (/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin) required for npm. Baseline verified green: npm run build exit 0; root npm test 47/47; frontend npm test 50/50.
